description: This file is a shell script containing a series of test cases for Git functionalities, specifically testing commit templates, sign-off, squash, and related options. It uses functions like 'test_expect_success' and 'test_must_fail' to automate testing Git commands, setup scenarios, and verify expected behaviors.

methods.name: commit_msg_is
methods.description: Compares the latest commit message with an expected string to verify the correctness of commit messages.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, runs the provided commands, and checks outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, flagging an error if it succeeds.

methods.name: commit_for_rebase_autosquash_setup
methods.description: Prepares a series of commits for testing rebase autosquash functionality.

methods.name: get_commit_msg
methods.description: Retrieves the full message body of a specific commit.
